label: read-people-funding
in_my_words: A small team doing fish-and-computer biology work mapped out who might help or pay them: fish scientists near Boston, grant programs, and company-style deals. They also tried to make sense of some rushed meeting notes and to work out what a tool called "Sentry" is. Everything is a guess to test; nobody has agreed to anything.
how_in_my_words: They searched public lists of scientists and checked those scientists' papers by their permanent codes. They read funders' own web pages and public rules on grants and who owns inventions. They matched the meeting-note lines to public facts. Two checkers re-read the key claims, and only backed claims were kept. Gaps were written down as unknown instead of guessed.

test_questions.question: Has anyone agreed to work with the team?
test_questions.my_answer: No. No one has been contacted and no one has agreed to anything.

test_questions.question: Which funders backed the frog-cell robots?
test_questions.my_answer: A Paul Allen foundation, DARPA and the National Science Foundation; later human-lung-cell robots also list Templeton and NIH.

test_questions.question: Which grant has no deadline?
test_questions.my_answer: Wellcome Discovery Awards, averaging about 3.5 million pounds; the NSF core biology call also takes proposals at any time.

test_questions.question: What exactly is the project's main scientific goal or research question?
test_questions.my_answer: I cannot tell. Only vague hints about fish fins, flying fish and maths proofs.

test_questions.question: What is the Sentry the note-taker meant?
test_questions.my_answer: Unknown. The text says they could not tell which Sentry was meant.

words_i_did_not_know: Lean / proof checker (why it matters to fish work)
sentences_i_could_not_follow: We did not check whether nobody funds proof-checking of biology; we only found no page that does.
A university deal is often different, but the one source we read is a single university system's checklist, so it does not speak for all universities.
Check two paper titles in the meeting-notes check
what_would_help: Open with one plain sentence saying what the project actually does and why fish, maths proofs and frog robots are connected. Explain the meeting notes and the Formlabs and Sentry tangents, or cut them.
